Residential Dining
Dining Plans
Incoming Student Dining Plan
Incoming Student Dining Plan
Choose one of our flexible dining plans that best suits your lifestyle and needs. Your Dining Dollars can be used to dine or shop at our nearly 20 residential dining and market locations throughout campus, regardless of your residential community. Plus, dining plans come with a minimum of $500 in Triton Cash , accepted at more than 60 locations on and off campus.
2026-27 Incoming Student Dining Plan Options
Here are some examples to help you determine which plan to choose*:
Triton Gold: $8,200 ($6,700 Dining Dollars + $1,500 Triton Cash)
We recommend this plan if…
You enjoy three full meals a day during the school week, plus snacks in between classes
You plan to eat some meals off campus during the weekends
Daily Dining Dollar spend estimate: $27/day
Triton Blue: $6,600 ($5,600 Dining Dollars + $1,000 Triton Cash)
We recommend this plan if…
You enjoy a light breakfast and lunch, and a hearty dinner
You plan to spend your weekends off campus
Daily Dining Dollar spend estimate: $23/day
Triton: $5,350 ($4,850 Dining Dollars + $500 Triton Cash)
We recommend this plan if…
Your dining routine is more spontaneous (i.e., a light lunch and hearty dinner one day, only breakfast and a light dinner the next)
You plan to pick up groceries from our markets to prepare group meals with your suitemates
Daily Dining Dollar spend estimate: $20/day
This plan does not guarantee or provide more than 10 meals per week.
Triton Community Plan: $1500 ($500 Dining Dollars + $1000 Triton Cash)
Only available to students eligible for Pepper Canyon East, Pepper Canyon West or Rita Atkinson Apartments.
2025-26 Incoming Student Dining Plan Options
Triton Gold: $7,800 ($6,300 Dining Dollars + $1,500 Triton Cash)
Triton Blue: $6,300 ($5,300 Dining Dollars + $1,000 Triton Cash)
Triton: $5,100 ($4,600 Dining Dollars + $500 Triton Cash)
Triton Community Plan: $1500 ($500 Dining Dollars + $1000 Triton Cash)
*Please note that the figures provided are Dining Dollar estimates. They do not include Triton Cash as purchases vary for each student.
